## What I built

<!--

- Demand forecasting (LightGBM) — 13-week forward forecast with prediction intervals
- Price elasticity (SCAN*PRO log-linear regression) across 40 SKUs
- Promotion effectiveness analysis
- An AI-grounded Q&A layer (Llama 3.3 70B via Groq) for natural-language queries against the live data
